purpose: Executable PUMA tissue-mask contract separated from nuclei annotations and conditioned on primary/metastatic site.

constraints.mask_statement: Require preprocessing/remap provenance, primary-versus-metastatic status, and source site before interpreting tissue labels or retrieving thresholds.
generation_handoff: Use primary/metastatic- and source-site-matched H&E references.
known_limitations: The repository mapping of PUMA epithelium to epidermis still requires raw label-spec verification.

constraints.mask_statement: Preserve every white-background/zero pixel exactly; background cannot seed, receive, bridge, or be filled by tissue edits.
generation_handoff: Do not inpaint protected background pixels.
known_limitations: Processing clefts and true slide background can appear similar on H&E but remain protected by the mask contract.

constraints.mask_statement: Change only declared tissue source IDs; preserve epithelium, necrosis, vessel, and every unrequested tissue label exactly, and never rasterize nuclei classes into new tissue-region labels.
generation_handoff: Preserve epidermal, necrotic, and vascular appearance; cell editing remains a separate workflow.
known_limitations: The semantic mask does not encode ulceration, junctional component, or regression.

constraints.mask_statement: Reject tumor islands/bridges, source splits, target merges, necrotic-hole filling, and any topology cleanup that consumes protected tissues.
known_limitations: Dedicated epidermal invasion, ulceration, necrosis, or perivascular tasks need separate primitives.
